auth.title: Sign in
auth.subtitle: Manage your menu from your phone.

errors.invalidPhone: Enter a valid Ugandan phone number, like 0772 123 456.
errors.phoneCountry: SMS codes only go to Ugandan numbers. Use email instead.

errors.tooMany: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes and try again.

errors.emailFailed: We couldn't send the email right now. Please try again.

sms.signInCode: Your {brand} code is {code}. It expires in 5 minutes.

invite.title: You're invited
invite.bodyOwner: You've been invited to manage {restaurant} on {brand}.
invite.bodyStaff: You've been invited to help at {restaurant} on {brand}.
invite.phoneHint: Sign in with the phone number ending in {digits}.
invite.expired: This invite has expired. Ask for a new one.
invite.revoked: This invite was cancelled. Ask for a new one.
invite.accepted: This invite has already been used. Sign in to continue.
invite.notFound: This invite link isn't valid. Check you copied all of it.

dashboard.title: Your restaurants

dashboard.comingSoon: Menu editing, tables and QR codes are being added here next.

errors.trialDays: Trial days must be between 0 and 365.
errors.agentCode: No active agent has that code.

created.title: {restaurant} is ready
created.body: Send the owner their sign-in link. It works once and expires in 14 days.

admin.inviteMessageEmail:

detail.newInviteHint: Makes a new link and cancels the old one.

home.intro: A QR menu for restaurants, cafés, lounges and bars. Diners scan, see your menu and order on WhatsApp.

diner.metaDescription: See the menu at {restaurant}{inArea}: {dishes}. Prices in UGX. Order on WhatsApp.
diner.emptyOrder: Nothing here yet. Tap a dish to add it.
diner.tableHint: From the QR code on your table.
diner.fallbackBody: Copy your order and send it on WhatsApp or by SMS to {phone}, or show it to a waiter.
diner.demoOrderTitle: This is the message the restaurant would get
diner.demoBanner: Demo menu: orders are not sent anywhere.
diner.demoNoContact: This is a demo menu, so calls and messages are turned off.
diner.notFoundBody: This menu link isn't working. Please ask a waiter for help.
diner.emptyMenu: The menu is being added. Please check back soon.
diner.offline: You're offline. This is the menu saved on your phone.

print.tagline: No app needed · Order on WhatsApp
print.taglineView: No app needed · See prices and photos

qr.title: QR codes
qr.intro: Print these and put them on your tables. Each code opens your menu; table codes also tell you which table ordered.
qr.wholeRestaurantHint: For the door, the counter or social media. No table number.
qr.noTables: No tables yet. Tables are added in the dashboard.
qr.freePlan: On the Free plan you get one QR code for the whole restaurant. Upgrade to Standard for a code on every table.
qr.tentsHint: One A4 page per table. Fold along the dashed line.
qr.stickersHint: Six stickers on each A4 sheet. Cut along the dashed lines.

editor.title: Menu
editor.staffIntro: Tap a dish to mark it sold out. Diners see it straight away.
editor.emptyMenu: Your menu is empty. Add a section like "Breakfast" or "Drinks", then add dishes to it.
editor.emptyCategory: No dishes in this section yet.
editor.deleteCategoryConfirm: Delete "{name}" and its {count} dishes? They disappear from your menu.
editor.deleteItemConfirm: Delete "{name}"? It disappears from your menu.
editor.name: Name
editor.priceUnclear: Check this price: did you mean {suggestion}?
editor.priceFromSizes: Leave empty when the dish is priced by size.
editor.descriptionPlaceholder: What's in it? One or two lines.
editor.sizesHint: Each size has its own price, e.g. Small UGX 4,000, Large UGX 6,000.
editor.addonsHint: Extras with a price on top, e.g. Extra egg + UGX 1,000.
editor.hiddenToggle: Hide this dish from the menu
editor.lugandaHint: Only fill these in if you have the Luganda wording. Leave them empty otherwise.
editor.duplicated: Copy made (hidden until you show it).
editor.freeNotice: On the Free plan, our team updates your menu for you. Send us what to change.
editor.freeLimit: Only the first {limit} dishes show on the Free plan.
editor.viewOnly: You can see the menu, but only the owner can change it.
editor.bulkIntro: Raise or lower many prices at once, e.g. +10% on all drinks.
editor.bulkPercentHint: Use a minus sign to lower prices, e.g. -5.

errors.notAllowed: You can't change this on your current plan.
errors.invalid: Please check the details and try again.
errors.priceRequired: Add a price, or add sizes with their own prices.
errors.optionPrice: Every size and add-on needs a price.

photos.cropHint: Drag to move. Use the slider to zoom.

errors.format: This photo can't be read. Choose a JPG or PNG photo, or take a screenshot of it.
errors.tooBig: This photo is too big. Choose a smaller one.
errors.failed: The photo didn't upload. Check your connection and try again.
errors.tooMany: Too many uploads. Wait a while and try again.

profile.title: Profile
profile.intro: What diners see at the top of your menu.
profile.saved: Saved. Your menu shows the changes now.
profile.coverHint: A wide photo of your place or your food.
profile.brandColorHint: Used for buttons and headings on your menu.
profile.name: Restaurant name
profile.descriptionPlaceholder: e.g. Breakfast, local food and grills. Fresh juice every day.
profile.addressPlaceholder: e.g. Ntinda Road, opposite the shopping centre
profile.mapPinHint: So diners can find you on Google Maps.
profile.locationFailed: We couldn't get your location. Allow location access, or paste a Google Maps link.
profile.pasteMapLink: Or paste a Google Maps link
profile.mapLinkInvalid: That link has no map position in it. In Google Maps, press and hold your place, then copy the link.
profile.hoursHint: For bars open past midnight, a closing time like 2:00 means 2am the next day.
profile.deliveryNotePlaceholder: e.g. We deliver in Ntinda and Naguru. Delivery UGX 2,000.
profile.momoHint: Diners see these to pay you with MoMo.

errors.name: Enter your restaurant's name.
errors.whatsapp: Enter a valid WhatsApp number, like 0772 123 456.
errors.hours: Check the opening hours: each open day needs an opening and a closing time.

tables.title: Tables and QR codes
tables.intro: Add your tables, then print a QR code for each one. When a diner orders, you'll see which table it came from.
tables.addHint: Numbers, ranges like 1-12, or names, separated by commas.
tables.deleteConfirm: Delete {name}? Its QR code will open the menu without a table number.
tables.freePlan: On the Free plan you get one QR code for the whole restaurant. Upgrade to Standard for a QR code on every table.

errors.empty: Type at least one table number or name.
errors.tooMany: Add at most 200 tables at a time.

request.title: Ask us to make changes
request.intro: Tell us what to change. We'll do it and let you know on WhatsApp.
request.setupIntro: Take clear photos of your paper menu, one page at a time. We'll type it in for you, usually within a day.
request.notesPlaceholder: e.g. Rolex is now UGX 6,000. Add passion juice, large UGX 6,000.
request.sent: Thank you! We got your request and will be in touch on WhatsApp.

errors.empty: Write what to change, or add photos of your menu.
errors.failed: We couldn't send your request. Please try again.

errors.count: You can add up to {max} files.
errors.failed: {name} didn't upload. Check your connection and try again.

onboarding.intro: It takes two minutes. You can change everything later.

onboarding.whatsappHint: Orders from your menu go to this number.
onboarding.logoIntro: Your logo shows at the top of your menu.
onboarding.howTitle: How would you like to add your menu?
onboarding.photoHint: Take photos of your paper menu. We read it for you; you check it and publish.
onboarding.sendUsHint: Send photos and the Menyu team sets it up for you.
